Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Cover Riots
Cardtype: Ally
Discipline: Auspex/Potence/Presence
Mortal with 1 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed. Requires an anarch. Cumulative.
[aus] Tap and burn to reduce a bleed against you by 1; by 2 if the acting vampire is titled.
This ally can bleed at +1 bleed as a  action that burns this ally; it gets +1 bleed during that action if the Methuselah you are bleeding controls a titled vampire.
[pot] This ally gets +1 strength and an additional +1 strength in combat against a titled vampire.

Cumulative is a short-cut for the keystone kine template.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
